question: Which wise seers are described as devoted to various scriptures?
premises: some seers know Veda Sāṃkhya Purāṇas
some are devoted to other scriptures
inference: The verse classifies learned seers by their scriptural devotion.
uncertainties: whether ye modifies all preceding nouns
plain_english: Those wise seers who know Veda, Sāṃkhya, and Purāṇas, devoted to Pāñcarātra, and devoted to other scriptures.
